documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Meeting Of Board
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Management reported a standalone revenue from operations of ₹ 1,173.25 lakhs and a consolidated revenue from operations of ₹ 11,642.04 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The Company highlighted strategic developments including the operationalization of the "Prabha" DP2 Accommodation Barge and the incorporation of Beluga International (IFSC) Private Limited in GIFT City. The Board of Directors did not recommend any dividend for the financial year in light of planned capital expenditures. Additionally, management detailed risks and concerns spanning market, operational, safety, financial, technological, and human resource dimensions. Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited held its 46th Annual General Meeting on August 30, 2025, and submitted its annual report for FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: The global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.
demand_outlook.quote: Global offshore oil and gas activity continues to strengthen, supported by sustained investments in energy security, increasing deepwater developments, and the need to offset production declines from mature fields.

demand_outlook.claim: The global supply of specialized Dynamic Positioning Class 2 accommodation barges remains limited compared with increasing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The global supply of such specialized assets remains limited compared with increasing demand, supporting healthy utilization levels and improving charter opportunities for technically capable operators.

demand_outlook.claim: The offshore support vessel market remains in an upcycle driven by higher offshore capital expenditure, improving utilization levels and constrained vessel supply.
demand_outlook.quote: The offshore support vessel market remains in an upcycle driven by higher offshore capital expenditure, improving utilization levels and constrained vessel supply.

demand_outlook.claim: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialised marine assets and limited fleet additions.
demand_outlook.quote: The medium-term outlook for the offshore services sector remains favourable, supported by sustained offshore investment, increasing demand for specialised marine assets and limited fleet additions.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that India's role in global oil markets is expected to expand substantially, driven by strong economic and population growth.
demand_outlook.quote: According to IEA (India Energy Outlook 2023) India’s role in global oil markets is expected to expand substantially over the remainder of the decade, fuelled by strong growth in its economy, population and demographics.

demand_outlook.claim: The market is projected to remain buoyant as ONGC proposes to issue high-value tenders in brown and green fields.
demand_outlook.quote: The market is expected to remain buoyant in the coming years as ONGC proposes to come out with many high value tenders in brown & green fields.

demand_outlook.claim: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs) are experiencing high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.
demand_outlook.quote: PSV are in high demand following robust activities on offshore platforms.

capex_expansion.claim: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.
capex_expansion.quote: In response to this market opportunity, Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited is planning for acquiring new vessels depending on the proximity of contract.

capex_expansion.claim: Strategic expansion will be financed through a combination of debt and equity.
capex_expansion.quote: This strategic expansion will be financed through a combination of debt and equity, aligning with the company’s growth ambitions and current market dynamics.

margins_costs.claim: Shipyards have increased newbuild pricing indexes by over 20 percent driven by high steel costs and limited yard capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Shipyards have increased newbuild pricing indexes by over 20%, driven by high steel costs and limited yard capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The annual consolidated turnover of the Company as on 31st March, 2026 is 116.42 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: The annual consolidated turnover of the Company as on 31st March, 2026 is 116.42 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended not recommending any interim or final dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors have not recommended any Interim Dividend as well as any final dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2024 on Equity Shares of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Volatility in Oil Prices: Offshore vessels heavily rely on the oil and gas industry. Fluctuations in oil prices can lead to reduced demand for vessels, affecting profitability.

risks_headwinds.claim: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.
risks_headwinds.quote: Weather and Sea Conditions: Adverse weather and harsh sea conditions can disrupt operations, damage vessels, and pose safety risks to crew members.

risks_headwinds.claim: Vessels operating in certain regions may face the threat of piracy or armed attacks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Piracy and Armed Attacks: Vessels operating in certain regions may face the threat of piracy or armed attacks, leading to potential loss of assets and crew.

risks_headwinds.claim: Increasing digitalization of vessel operations raises the risk of cyber-attacks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Cybersecurity: Increasing digitalization of vessel operations raises the risk of cyber-attacks, which could disruptoperations or lead to data breaches.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operators may face liquidity issues if they are unable to secure contracts or if payments from clients are delayed.
risks_headwinds.quote: Liquidity Risks: Operators may face liquidity issues if they are unable to secure contracts or if payments from clients are delayed.

risks_headwinds.claim: Wage inflation or a domestic shortage of qualified marine crew and commercial divers could drive up operating costs or stall execution timelines.
risks_headwinds.quote: Wage inflation or a domestic shortage of qualified marine crew and commercial divers could drive up operating costs or stall execution timelines.

management_commitments.claim: The directors assure the stakeholders of the Company to continue their efforts and enhance the overall performance of the Company in the coming financial years.
management_commitments.quote: Your directors assure the stakeholders of the Company to continue their efforts and enhance the overall performance of the Company in the coming financial years.
